# Energy With Mark

Energy With Mark is the public solar, battery and energy-advice website of Mark Fitzpatrick, Renewable Energy Specialist in Australia.

## Purpose
The site explains solar, batteries, power bills and energy decisions in plain English. General website content is educational. Customer-specific recommendations require customer-specific information such as a recent electricity bill, site details, existing equipment and goals.

## Knowledge topics
The knowledge hub contains evergreen guides about solar sizing, battery sizing, solar self-consumption, EV impacts, blackout backup expectations, commercial solar, demand charges, existing solar, electricity bills, proposals and assessment preparation.

## Editorial boundary
AI may help organise and improve public educational material, but adviser-approved facts remain authoritative. Time-sensitive government incentives, pricing, financial forecasts, product specifications, legal wording and customer-specific recommendations are not automatically published by the Website Growth Agent.
